answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware remote-attestation quote from a distinct secure enclave, like stamping every crate on the wharf with a copper seal the harbor master can verify but nobody can forge. The protocol admits one identity per unique signed platform measurement, so a sybil farm cannot mint a thousand masks from one box: each fake demands another genuine secure processor. Attacker cost then scales linearly in physical chips, not in cheap software clones, which is exactly the point.
